test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Draw the line

options.text: To move on from a past relationship
To set a limit on something

solution: The correct answer is **To set a limit on something** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Draw the line is an *idiom *that* *generally means, to put a limit on what you will do or allow to happen__ (**एक सीमा लगाने के लिए**). • ​Ex: *I'll do whatever my company asks me to, but **I draw the line** when someone asks me to lie for them.* • *​*Hence, the option with the correct meaning of the given idiom is, To set a limit on something. *Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4).* 4b:Tdc4,
